review_locator: PMCID:PMC3432803, Activation of B cells by non-canonical helper signals; PMCID:PMC3262910, B-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
primary_title: B-cell-helper neutrophils stimulate immunoglobulin diversification and production in the marginal zone of the spleen
decision_basis: The review identifies the Puga primary showing that IL-10 exposure reprograms human circulating neutrophils toward an inducible B-cell-helper phenotype with increased BAFF/TNFSF13B expression.
limitations_preserved: Reprogramming gene-expression bridge; preserve recombinant IL-10 exposure and human inducible neutrophil context, distinguish BAFF transcript from BAFF protein release, and do not infer a specific endothelial source, sole STAT3 mechanism, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effect.
